course_name_original: Automation and robotization of manufacturing and intralogistics systems
course_name_en: Automation and robotization of manufacturing and intralogistics systems
syllabus_topics: Tool systems in lathes, including tool heads and automatic tool measurement
Machining automation, exemplified by a multi-axis turning and milling center
Tool systems, including tool coding systems
Computer systems for tool management, including instrumentation, automatic dispensers, and tool measurement systems
Programming selected machine tool functions (machine PLC), such as additional controlled axes, warehouse control, and management of semi-finished products and finished products
